title: Drawer
summary: Workspace side panel that keeps the page usable: docked column or modeless panel. Modal side panels belong to sf-modal; the modal Drawer mode is deprecated.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

placement.description: The edge the panel opens from: inline-start or inline-end follow the document direction and are the ones to use; left and right are physical (right, the default, stays right in a right-to-left page); bottom is a bottom sheet.

snap.description: A bottom sheet's resting height: its content's, half the room under the app bar, or all of it.

overlay.description: Draws the scrim behind a modal panel; a modeless panel has none.

modal.description: A modal panel holds the focus, locks the page's scrolling and gives the focus back when it closes (the default, kept for compatibility); false: a modeless panel beside a page that stays usable. A docked panel is modeless while it has room.

docked.description: A column of the page layout, which makes room for it, while its dock host (or the window) is at least dock-breakpoint wide; narrower, it floats over the page.

size.description: The panel's width step: 1/2, 1, 2 or full; width replaces it.

close-on-esc.description: Escape closes the top panel, while it is dismissible.

close-on-overlay.description: A press on the scrim closes the top panel, while it is dismissible.

preserve-scroll-gap.description: While a modal panel locks the page, adds the scrollbar's width to the page's end padding so the content does not shift; false leaves the padding alone.

show-close.description: Draws the close button (not while a controlled panel's outside switch is on screen).

controlled.description: An outside switch (an element naming the drawer in aria-controls) opens and closes the panel: no close button while that switch is on screen.

close-placement.description: Where the close button stands: inside the panel's head, or outside, on the panel's edge.

heading.description: The panel's title in its head; the panel is labelled by it when label is empty.

label.description: The panel's accessible name (aria-label); empty: the heading names it.

close-label.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Close drawer" in English).

width.description: The panel's width, a CSS length (sets --sf-drawer-width); empty: the size step's width.

stack-offset.description: How much of each drawer below shows past the one above it at the same edge, as a length (for example var(--sf-space-4)). A drawer stands depth × offset in from its edge, where depth counts the open, undocked drawers below it at that edge. Empty: drawers lie flush.

dock-breakpoint.description: From what width of the dock host (or the window, without a host) a docked drawer is a column of the page; narrower, it floats over the page and is modal (unless modal=false). A length in rem, em or px. Empty: the --sf-drawer-dock-breakpoint variable where the drawer stands, else 48rem.

block-start.description: Where this panel starts from the top (an app bar's height); the --sf-drawer-block-start variable sets it for every panel.

gutter.description: The inline gutter the head and the body share, as a length (for example var(--sf-space-3)), so the title and the content start on one axis. Empty: the drawer's own, space-1. A theme may set --sf-drawer-gutter instead.

z-index.description: The panel's z-index, replacing its place in the shared layer scale (by default var(--sf-drawer-z-index) raised by its depth in the stack).

panel-style.description: Declarations set on the panel itself, for the custom properties it reads -- its background, radius, shadow. A consumer painting its content a different colour than the panel leaves the head and the gutters in the other one.

unsaved.description: Something in the panel is unsaved: the close request (sf-drawer-close) carries it as detail.unsaved, so a page can ask before it lets the panel close.

dismissible.description: false: Escape and a press on the scrim no longer close the panel; its close button, close() and the page's own controls still do.

dock_host.description: A host element marked data-sf-drawer-dock-host receives padding-inline-start/end equal to the summed widths of open docked drawers per logical side, published as --sf-drawer-dock-inline-start/end on the document root. A host narrower than the drawer's threshold (dock-breakpoint, else --sf-drawer-dock-breakpoint, else 48rem) keeps zero padding for it. A toggle switch outside the drawer (data-drawer="toggle" naming it in aria-controls, or data-sf-drawer-toggle) hides and shows a docked column and carries aria-expanded. A docked drawer with the room is a column of the page (data-sf-drawer-column="true" on its root): surface-0, no shadow; without the room it floats over the page with the raised surface and shadow. --sf-drawer-background overrides both.

slots.description: The named slots the consumer fills.

default.description: The drawer's content, moved into the scrolling body.

edge.description: Stands beside the panel, on its outer edge, where the panel's own clipping cannot reach it.

open.summary: Opens the Drawer, or brings it to the front when already open. Dispatches sf-drawer-open (cancelable) and later sf-drawer-opened unless options.emit is false. Returns the element.

close.summary: Closes the Drawer and returns focus (to the opener when it is the top layer; a drawer closing under another layer moves no focus). Dispatches sf-drawer-close (cancelable) and sf-drawer-closed unless options.emit is false; options.reason says why (close, escape, outside, cancelled, api; api by default). Returns the element.

toggle.summary: Calls close() when open, open() otherwise. Returns the element.

setState.summary: An open key calls open() or close(); the remaining keys go to the base setState as host attributes. Returns the element.

getState.summary: Returns the current template context plus the open state.

onBeforeOpen.summary: Adds a listener for sf-drawer-open on the host that runs only for this Drawer's own events. Returns the element.

onAfterOpen.summary: Adds a listener for sf-drawer-opened on the host that runs only for this Drawer's own events. Returns the element.

onBeforeClose.summary: Adds a listener for sf-drawer-close on the host that runs only for this Drawer's own events. Returns the element.

onAfterClose.summary: Adds a listener for sf-drawer-closed on the host that runs only for this Drawer's own events. Returns the element.

setSnap.summary: Sets a bottom sheet's resting height (auto, half or full) and dispatches sf-drawer-snapped when it changes. Returns the element.

drawer:ready.summary: The portal surface is ready. Bubbles and is composed; detail.drawer is the emitting drawer.

root.description: The rendered drawer root ([data-sf-drawer-root]) in its portal.

drawer:update.summary: The portal surface was updated. Bubbles and is composed; detail.drawer is the emitting drawer.

root.description: The rendered drawer root ([data-sf-drawer-root]) in its portal.

drawer:before-open.summary: Cancelable intent before opening. Bubbles and is composed; detail.drawer is the emitting drawer. Its detail is sf-drawer-open's with component, drawer (the element) and root (its rendered root) added.

root.description: The rendered drawer root ([data-sf-drawer-root]) in its portal.

drawer:after-open.summary: The Drawer was opened. Bubbles and is composed; detail.drawer is the emitting drawer. Its detail is sf-drawer-opened's with component, drawer (the element) and root (its rendered root) added.

root.description: The rendered drawer root ([data-sf-drawer-root]) in its portal.

drawer:before-close.summary: Cancelable intent before closing. Bubbles and is composed; detail.drawer is the emitting drawer. Its detail is sf-drawer-close's with component, drawer (the element) and root (its rendered root) added.

reason.description: Why it closes (standard 1.3.8 §19.3): its own close control, Escape, a press outside, a page control that closes it, or a script.

unsaved.description: Whether something is unsaved; false until the component has an unsaved setting.

root.description: The rendered drawer root ([data-sf-drawer-root]) in its portal.

drawer:after-close.summary: The Drawer was closed. Bubbles and is composed; detail.drawer is the emitting drawer. Its detail is sf-drawer-closed's with component, drawer (the element) and root (its rendered root) added.

reason.description: Why it closes (standard 1.3.8 §19.3): its own close control, Escape, a press outside, a page control that closes it, or a script.

root.description: The rendered drawer root ([data-sf-drawer-root]) in its portal.

drawer:snap.summary: A bottom sheet came to rest at another height (handle, swipe or setSnap()). Its detail is sf-drawer-snapped's with component, drawer (the element) and root (its rendered root) added.

root.description: The rendered drawer root ([data-sf-drawer-root]) in its portal.

accessibility.focus: Modal Drawer moves focus inside, traps Tab on the top instance and restores an available opener. Modeless Drawer does not trap focus or lock the page. Docked Drawer is a named role=region column: no focus trap, no scroll lock; Escape closes the top instance.

deprecations.path: modal (default mode without docked or modal=false)

changes: Add docked: a modeless role=region column that reserves page space through data-sf-drawer-dock-host.
Existing modal and modeless behavior is unchanged when docked is absent.
Escape already handled by an editor or drag (defaultPrevented) does not close the drawer.
Drawer is scoped to docked and modeless workspace panels.
The modal mode stays the default for compatibility but is deprecated; use sf-modal with position="inline-start|inline-end" for modal side panels.
drawer:* events bubble and are composed, so hosts can listen on the document; detail.drawer names the emitting drawer.
onBeforeOpen, onAfterOpen, onBeforeClose and onAfterClose still receive only that drawer's own events.
Ancestor listeners added with addEventListener now also see events of nested drawers; check event.detail.drawer.

A docked drawer without the room (dock host or window narrower than its dock-breakpoint) floats over the page as a modal panel: scrim, focus kept inside, page lock, Escape, focus returned to its opener. A docked column is unchanged.
modal="false" on a docked drawer keeps it modeless when it floats, as before.
A modal drawer's Tab cycle runs through the panel and then its edge (close, copy-link, open-full of sf-view-properties); a focus on the edge counts as inside.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-drawer for a workspace side panel next to a page that stays usable: docked (page content shifts, both sides at once; below its dock-breakpoint it floats over the page as a modal panel) or modal=false (overlapping, no scrim, no focus trap). For a modal side panel use sf-modal with position="inline-start|inline-end".
do_not: Do not use a modal sf-drawer for new interfaces; use sf-modal with a side position
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not use overlay as a substitute for modal semantics
Do not pass literal design dimensions when a standard size or Framework token exists
